scope: Targeted static review of project/task models and SQLite schema excerpts, JSON-RPC procedure registration and task/subtask/link/comment/file/metadata paths, authentication/authorization, normal and alternate mutation writers, position/recurrence/conversion, queue/event/history/notifications, board refresh and drag, plugins/deployment and selected test assertions. Core model/API/schema operation inventory searched for lease/heartbeat/attempt/claim/idempotency alternatives. Not every-line, all migration/backend/import/duplication/plugin/security/browser/runtime certification.

lifecycle_review.create: Project initialization transaction; task row then positions/tags/jobs outside one universal transaction; failure integer zero and downstream strict-false conversion mismatch; API validates fields and membership/assignee rather than operation idempotency.
lifecycle_review.select: Project/search/status/assignee and link-label queries for human/client selection; no dependency-ready atomic acquisition in inspected core registered procedures or task/status/position writers; WIP template highlights rather than admission guard.
lifecycle_review.claim: UI assign-to-me, API owner update and unassigned-owner automatic action feed id-only TaskModificationModel update; read/event owner checks not storage CAS; no execution-attempt lease or cross-worker fence.
lifecycle_review.progress: Description/comments, metadata and subtask time tracking persist context but mutable unfenced state; file object written before SQL row, key hashes filename and seconds not content; no mandatory result/artifact pin.
lifecycle_review.review: Column/helper/role and confirmation conventions; no qualified separate reviewer or accepted-result transition required by core close; API permissions and application-wide token scope distinct.
lifecycle_review.complete: Task close updates all subtasks done before independent task closure; no accepted-child/dependency/evidence gate; close-column action shares same model; move-to-project directly reopens and can return true despite false SQL update.
lifecycle_review.cancel: Reopen/reassign/delete records only, no native worker cancellation or external effect compensation; file deletion and task deletion separate; alternate mutations lack attempt conditions.
lifecycle_review.recover: SQL records survive clients but no native process/attempt restoration; JSON-RPC request ID only response correlation; recurrence create then parent mark not atomic; sync/optional queue separate from task write, caught job exception then completion; event rebuild current snapshot, conditional user activity, no webhook delivery ledger, polling timestamp freshness limits.

files.method: Pinned documentation, license, dependency/deployment manifest inspection; README used for declared maintenance posture, not proof of runtime features.
